tools.name: amazon_marketplaces
tools.description: List the 22 Amazon stores the other amazon_* tools support — code, domain, country, currency, the NBP table its currency converts with, default and available languages, and whether it is in the EU (no customs to Poland). Static and free: call it to pick marketplaces without guessing.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: amazon_search, amazon_compare · Public sink: amazon_search · Destructive: amazon_compare.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: amazon_search, amazon_compare · Public sink: amazon_search · Destructive: amazon_compare

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
